header: What Atlas offers the people it hires
subheadline: Atlas Studio is employee-owned, so benefits are set in the same meeting as the rate card. Candidates ask about these three before they sign.

perks.title: Four-day week, full pay
perks.description: The studio closes on Fridays. In 2023, client hours dropped to 28 a week, and the rate card covered the difference.

perks.title: EUR 2,000 learning budget
perks.description: Courses, conferences and books, with no sign-off needed. Most of it goes on research training and typography.

perks.title: Six weeks working anywhere
perks.description: Once a project is past discovery, you can work from any time zone within two hours of CET for six weeks a year.
